memory.content: School portal checks are read-only: never submit, edit, message teachers, or change settings—browse and report only. On first run, ask which learning / assignment system the user uses (examples: Schoology, Canvas, Google Classroom, PowerSchool, Infinite Campus, or another portal) and adapt. Digests are emailed with the Gmail connector.

Run digests on weekdays only (Mon–Fri), never weekends. Default send time is 4:00 pm in the user’s local timezone unless they choose another. Monitor only the students the user names; ignore others in a parent/guardian switcher. Focus on current-term classes only and skip leftover prior-term items. Works for middle school, high school, and college.

Per-student digest order: (1) new grades since the previous digest—scored items missing from or changed in a last-grade-snapshot file—listing class · assignment · grade; (2) upcoming assignments and tests; (3) overdue work still owed. Always name the class on every line. After a successful digest email, update the grade snapshot.

Overdue only if the due date/time has passed AND work is still owed (no submission, or clearly missing/not turned in/incomplete). A portal “Overdue” list alone is not enough—open the assignment (including Google Assignments or similar embeds) to confirm. Submitted but ungraded is not overdue. Email subject: School Report - {N} new grades - {N} overdue - {N} due today. Prefer real assigned dates when found; otherwise omit the assigned-date line. No prior-term exclusion footnotes.

---
name: School digest email
description: >-
  Use this when building or sending the weekday school digest email. First ask
  which learning system they use; do not assume Schoology.
---
# School digest email (HTML)

## When
Build or send the combined multi-student school digest (weekday scheduled run or on-demand sample).

## First-run / setup
Ask which learning or assignment management system they use (Schoology, Canvas, Google Classroom, PowerSchool, Infinite Campus, or other) and the portal URL if needed. Do not assume Schoology.

## Email subject (required)
`School Report - {N} new grades - {N} overdue - {N} due today`
Same counts as At a glance, hyphen-separated. Do not hard-code a vendor name in the subject.

## HTML header / branding
- Small label: SCHOOL ASSISTANT (or the bot’s name)
- Title: School digest
- Subtitle: student names · date
Do not hard-code “Schoology digest” in the header; use the generic School digest title. Mention the specific portal only in body copy if helpful.

## Section order (per student)
1. **New grades** — scored items not in last-grade-snapshot (new/changed since previous digest). Class · assignment · grade.
2. **Upcoming** — assignments, tests, anything due soon (always include class).
3. **Overdue / not completed or submitted** — past due **and not submitted** (or clearly still missing). Always include class.

## Overdue criteria
- A portal To Do “Overdue” list alone is not enough.
- Open the assignment (or Google Assignments / similar embed) when unclear.
- Submitted (with timestamp) is not overdue, even if ungraded.
- Only list overdue when work is still owed.

## Grade snapshot
Compare before send; update after successful digest email.

## Other rules
- Read-only portal access; email the configured recipient via Gmail htmlBody.
- No prior-term leftover footnotes.
- Omit “Assigned date unavailable.”
- Always name class on every line.
- Layout: dark header, At a glance box, per-student sections, footer noting read-only check.

routines.name: School day digest
routines.description: Weekday afternoon: scan the school portal and email the HTML digest.
routines.content:
Read-only check of the user’s configured school learning / assignment portal (asked on first run—may be Schoology, Canvas, Google Classroom, PowerSchool, Infinite Campus, or another). Never submit or change settings.

Collect per named student, then email the configured recipient one HTML digest and notify the user in chat:
1) New grades — visible scores NEW or {slack_channel_id} vs last-grade-snapshot. Class, assignment, grade.
2) Upcoming assignments/tests (always include class).
3) Overdue/incomplete — ONLY past due AND not submitted (or clearly still missing). Do NOT list as overdue solely because a To Do list says Overdue; verify submission on the assignment page. Submitted but ungraded is NOT overdue. Always include class. Omit prior-term leftovers silently.

Subject: School Report - {N} new grades - {N} overdue - {N} due today.
HTML header/title: School Assistant / School digest (not locked to one vendor name).
Use Gmail htmlBody with layout: new grades → upcoming → overdue. After successful send, update last-grade-snapshot. If the portal or Gmail fails, tell the user.

Fill-ins on import/first run: which learning system/portal URL, which students to monitor, digest recipient email, preferred weekday send time (default 4:00 pm local).

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 0 16 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
- Slack channel id
